name: Suzhou Institute of Building Science Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou Institute of Building Science Group Co., Ltd., a Chinese firm based in Suzhou, operates within the country's construction industry. Established in 1979, the company delivers a wide array of services, including architectural planning, engineering project oversight, waterproof finishing applications, structural reinforcement, and quality assurance inspections. It also provides industry-specific education and training. Furthermore, Suzhou Institute is actively involved in sustainable construction and urban development. This encompasses research, design, construction, product innovation, testing, technical advisory, and sales representation for green building initiatives, energy-saving technologies, and related equipment. The company also contributes to urban regeneration projects. In terms of products, it manufactures and distributes various construction materials. This range includes waterproofing agents, interior and exterior latex paints, concrete additives, building adhesives, stone curing compounds, and external thermal insulation systems. Its comprehensive solutions are utilized across diverse sectors such as rail transportation networks, integrated urban utility corridors, sustainable urban water management (sponge cities), urban revitalization schemes, specialized town developments, and water conservancy and hydroelectric infrastructure, among other areas.
